furniture/furniture_holosign_lattice.jso: A slab of soft light turning on nothing, dense with glyphs that rearrange the moment you understand them. The world answers two ways: TYPE what you want, or CLICK the glowing links. Six STATS are the clay of you, and XP buys more with RAISE. SKILLS come from practice. USE the holosign to reach in.
furniture/furn_library_terminal.json: A squat brass lending terminal, pre-Collapse municipal issue, kept running by somebody who enjoys the work. A tablet dock sits in the top, worn bright. The screen reads PLACE TABLET. TAKE WHAT YOU LIKE. Dock yours and it installs the LIBRARY app and the whole catalogue, readable anywhere you go.
furniture/furn_corp_poster_start_b.json: A laminated card screwed to the wall beside the vats, its corners furred from a decade of thumbs. COLDWATER CLONE FACILITY: CONDITIONS OF DISCHARGE. Five numbered lines in the flat voice of a committee, the last of them being: don't re-enter the vat hall. Somebody has inked under it: THEY MEAN IT.
furniture/furn_vendor_safe_juno.json: A matte-black security enclosure the size of a microwave, bolted into the concrete behind the counter. No seam, no keyway, no reader. The face is electrochromic glass cycling between mirror and opaque, and nothing's visibly inside when it clears. Etched beside it: PROPERTY OF VENDOR. MONITORED.
furniture/furn_solenne_tv_apt_b.json: Eighty-eight inches of flat glass in a brushed-chrome bezel, wall-hung facing the bed, thinner than a knife. None of the fishbowl bulge, none of the salvaged-CRT wobble everyone else watches the world through. The picture just sits there and stays put. CHROMAVISION is etched across the bottom rail.
furniture/furn_precinct_clone_vat.json: A clone vat bolted into the corner of the cell, none of the civic finish: scarred acrylic in a steel cradle, nutrient lines taped rather than plumbed, PRECINCT 9 · CUSTODIAL DECANT stencilled across it. Die with an open file and you finish printing in here. Not punishment. Routing.
furniture/furn_solenne_piano.json: An upright in black lacquer where the glass ends, lid propped, music desk empty. The fallboard carries a maker's name in worn gilt nobody here could pronounce. It's tuned, which is the expensive part: somebody comes up eighteen floors twice a year. The middle keys are a shade warmer.
furniture/furn_corp_poster_start_a.json: A brand-new poster pasted where a fresh clone can't miss it. A grinning figure holds a whole district in one open palm the way a promo still holds a burger. In focus-grouped Franchise green: YOU'VE BEEN REPRINTED. NOW MAKE IT COUNT. Below: start a Corp, belong to something that wins.
furniture/furn_poster_twocell_supply.jso: A hand-pasted advert, hung crooked, on paper thin enough to show the wall through it. Most of it's Grady photographed from below, gazing at a horizon located above the vending machine. TWO-CELL SUPPLY. EAST ALONG THE STREET. HONEST PRICES. HONEST WORK. GEAR FOR EVERY CAREER PATH.
furniture/furn_echelon_main_engine.json: The Echelon's main engine: a vast block of turbined steel filling the compartment floor to overhead, cowlings warm and thrumming. Brass inspection plates, colour-coded fuel and coolant lines, analogue gauges trembling off their pins. Everything aboard draws from here through the junction box.
furniture/furn_sump_pit_bench.json: A bench built from a dock pallet and two courses of breeze block, topped with foam that was upholstery once. The bar's a length of scaffold pole, knurled where hands wore the galvanising off, and the plates are cast iron, poured concrete, one truck brake disc. There's no rack. Lie down and lift.
furniture/furn_cardmint_mintcond.json: A mint press on a low plinth at the end of the counter, kept under a dust cover, the carpet in front worn to the weave. This is the good one: a decommissioned civic press, bought at auction and rebuilt by a man with strong opinions about registration error. Engraved by hand: IT IS A RECORD OF YOU.
furniture/furn_sump_pit_tally.json: A sheet of ply screwed to the wall and painted over every season, so the old numbers stand up through the new in low relief. The current column is chalk: DUTCH, LOTTIE, VESS, and a fourth rewritten until the ply gave up. At the bottom, in paint: THE SLAG DOESN'T CARE WHO YOU WERE.
furniture/furn_library_shelves.json: Three shelves of salvaged fiction, sorted by a system that's clearly personal and clearly rigorous. Spines repaired with tape, thread, and once surgical adhesive. A pencilled verdict inside each front cover: "bleak, correct", "funny until it isn't". The disapproved-of lie face down on the bottom.
furniture/furn_sump_slag_pit.json: A ring of chalk scuffed into the concrete around the back-room drain: the Sump's reason for being. By day it's a stain you step over. By night two lines of regulars toe the chalk and it's an arena the width of a back room, which is no room to dodge. The drain takes the sweat and sometimes the loser.
furniture/furn_solenne_cryocell_lobby.js: A slab of matte ceramic no bigger than a footlocker, radiating cold you can feel through your boots. The lid seals with a soft magnetic sigh and a status ring glowing blue. Stamped along the seam: ZENITH ENTERPRISES CRYOCELL. No plumbing, no permit, no grid draw. What's inside stays frozen.
furniture/furn_sump_pit_wall.json: The back wall of the pit, faced in sheet steel, almost flat. Slags come off it hard and at an angle you learn or wear. The steel is dented in a loose constellation at chest height and one perfect crater near the joists. Chalk marks show where to stand; the nearest were redrawn closer, twice.
furniture/furn_cachet_v900.json: A Cachet Vantage 900: matte graphite, seamless, taller than you and about as wide as a coffin laid flat. Sample bolts of fabric sit on motorised trays under a hairline of warm light, and the facade is machined so precisely no join shows. Cachet calls it a discretion suite, and won't say what for.
furniture/furn_solenne_fridge_a.json: Brushed alloy, a shelf array that reconfigures itself around whatever you put in it, and an interior glow that comes on a half-second before the door's open, like it's been expecting you. A drop-freezer box sits up top. The plate reads POLARIS EXECUTIVE. Polite, efficient, and keeping track.
furniture/furn_solenne_fridge_b.json: Brushed alloy, a shelf array that reconfigures itself around whatever you put in it, and an interior glow that comes on a half-second before the door's open, like it's been expecting you. A drop-freezer box sits up top. The plate reads POLARIS EXECUTIVE. Polite, efficient, and keeping track.

furniture/furn_asc_uplink_terminal.json:
A slab of dark glass set into the Curtain, the hard white light behind it rather than on it. No keyboard, no seat. Two shallow depressions at hand height, worn smooth, and worn smooth from inside the glass as well.

A line of text stands in the surface, unlit, the way a thing waits: COMMIT.
furniture/furn_cachet_v900_solenne_b.jso: A Cachet Vantage 900 in apartment trim: matte graphite, floor to ceiling, a mirrored bar wall where a lesser flat would put a bookshelf. Bottles sit backlit on motorised shelves behind smoked glass, turned label-out by a mechanism you can hear but not see. Cachet calls it a discretion suite.
furniture/furn_wanted_board_bishops.json: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall: coin slot and thermal printer up top, an amber screen of open contracts, a round stainless port by your knees. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. DO NOT INSERT LIVING TISSUE. A card taped over the coin slot reads OUT OF ORDER. Under it, in different biro: IT ISN'T.
furniture/furn_wanted_board_grindhouse.j: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall: coin slot and thermal printer up top, an amber screen of open contracts, a round stainless port by your knees. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. DO NOT INSERT LIVING TISSUE. This one has been hit: cracked screen, scoured port, a gasket of inner tube. It weighs true.
furniture/furn_wanted_board_cherry.json: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall: coin slot and thermal printer up top, an amber screen of open contracts, a round stainless port by your knees with a scale behind it. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. DO NOT INSERT LIVING TISSUE. This one is looked after, wiped down every shift. Nobody will say who does it.
furniture/furn_cardmint_records.json: A records-office press, older than the bank ones and prouder about it. Decommissioned by somebody who loved it: housing wiped down, a proper fitted cover, the hand-lettered card still taped on. A CARD IS A RECORD. THE RECORD IS PERMANENT. Added in pen: SO ARE YOU. In pencil: MOVED TO IRONSIDE.
furniture/furn_the_reach_870_1958_flyer_: A burned-out flyer hulk dragged to the edge of the strip and left to the weather: wings gone, cockpit a black socket, the frame settling into the hardpan. Somebody welded empty fuel cans along a wing stub as a marker. Come in too fast, too heavy or too wanted, and this is the far end of the runway.
furniture/furn_stgarneau_plaque.json: A brushed-steel plaque the size of a hymn board: the open eye, and under it COMPLIANT PLACE OF WORSHIP · IX. It's fitted across the lintel carving and covers it precisely. The screw heads are burred and the holes gone oval. Behind the edges, where the weather never gets, the sandstone is cleaner.
furniture/furn_solenne_wardrobe_penthous: Not a wardrobe so much as a small room with doors. Two walls of it: mirrored, back-lit, rails on silent runners that bring a section of your life forward when you touch the brass. The air is cedar and cold money. VALET BY POLARIS, BESPOKE SERIES, and something behind the panelling keeps a record.
furniture/furn_exo_purifier.json: A dentist's chair with the upholstery long gone, bolted to the floor under a hood of salvaged medical gear and cable ties. STILLHOUSE is written on the hood in correction fluid, and under it, in another hand, IT DOES NOT HURT. What it takes out of you goes into a drum that's nearly full.
furniture/furn_solenne_chess_table.json: A card table of quartered walnut with a board inlaid flush into the top: ebony and holly, each square a separate piece of wood, the grain running the same way across all sixty-four. The set beside it's weighted rosewood and boxwood, kings collared in tarnished silver. Worth more than the chairs.
furniture/furn_betamax_zone_solenne_apt_: A slab of brushed titanium on its own machined shelf under the Chromavision, no bigger than a hardback and much heavier. The loading door has no catch: you offer it a cassette and it takes it, drawing it in over four seconds and closing without a sound. An amber bar reports what it's doing.
furniture/furn_bld_897_1175_the_board.js: A sheet of plywood by the ops desk, hand-lettered in three colours of paint marker: NO MANIFESTS. NO QUESTIONS. CASH ON THE SKID. Below it a pinned drift of curling paper: fuel debts, dead-reckoning charts, a flyer for a fight years ago, and a short list of names with lines drawn through them.
furniture/furn_reach_poker_table.json: A battered oval of felt gone bald in patches, ringed by four mismatched chairs under a tin lamp. The deck's hand-shuffled and squared at the dealer's end; the chips are old casino clay nobody asks about. The Reach plays close, and cheating gets you planted out in the scrub. 10/20 · $200 TO SIT.
furniture/furn_clone_soylent.json: A wall-mounted nutrient dispenser in clone-facility beige, bolted at chest height by the door. A cracked label reads NUTRITION IS A RIGHT, NOT A PRIVILEGE; somebody has scratched 'lol' beneath it. A dented steel tray waits under the nozzle. The display is dark and the power cord hangs loose.
furniture/furn_echelon_suite_drug_cabine: A tall apothecary cabinet built into the bulkhead beside the bar: smoked glass, brushed titanium, softly refrigerated. Behind the glass, ranked and labelled in a hand that didn't expect to answer to anyone, a pharmacy's worth of everything. LOOK IN it, or TAKE what you want; it restocks itself.
furniture/furn_exo_purifier_real.json: A dentist's chair with the upholstery long gone, bolted through the floor over the drain under a hood of salvaged medical gear. There's nothing written on this one. There are straps, they're lined with sheepskin, and the sheepskin has been replaced recently. The sealed drum outside is nearly full.
furniture/furn_sump_pit_circuit.json: Not equipment so much as a route: a stack of sand-filled kegs at one end of the room, a chalk line at the other, and the understanding that you carry them down and back until you can't. A knotted rope hangs off the joist for anyone who wants it worse. Lap markers on the floor stop at forty.
